identity.title: Lock direct EverRun package acceptance as a regression test

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Turn the production-derived fixture from 8070 into a deterministic regression test for the exact failure class found on 2026-08-23: manifest/timeline contract mismatch plus semantic projection collapse to unknown. The test must fail if schema/files/container shape or source-proven lifecycle/decision/validation/scope semantics regress.
human_pressure.why_now: A one-time dogfood pass is insufficient; the repaired producer-consumer contract must become executable evidence in the Ailuros suite.

machine_core.goal: Add one focused end-to-end regression test that exercises validate -> load -> ingest -> rebuild -> governed result using the 8070 fixture.
invariants: The fixture enters through the same public package path as any producer.
Source-private event types remain irrelevant to acceptance unless canonical facts depend on them.
Source-proven canonical facts must not fall back to unknown.

steps.title: Assert package contract
details: Validate manifest schema/files and timeline object envelope with the existing validator.

steps.title: Assert semantic projection
details: Assert terminal lifecycle plus validation/scope/decision-domain facts exactly where the fixture carries source evidence.

steps.title: Assert no accidental producer coupling
details: Test behavior through shared functions only; do not inspect source == everrun to choose behavior.

acceptance: The original structural failure class is covered by executable tests.
The original semantic-unknown failure class is covered by executable tests.
Tests use shared production code paths.

producer.artifact: end-to-end regression test covering structural and semantic-unknown failure classes

consumer.component: evidence package ingest and projection rebuild pipeline

observable_effect.assertion: Regression tests exercise validate, load, ingest, rebuild, and governed result via shared production code paths.

proofs.assertion: Focused and full test suites pass covering both failure classes.

must_check: 8070 fixture is the only new evidence dependency.
Regression assertions correspond to the real 2026-08-23 failure class.
No test branches on EverRun identity to alter semantics.
reject_if: Test only checks JSON shape and ignores the known semantic projection failures.
Producer identity selects a special code path.
